summary: P1-3 CMS migration testing. BACKEND: all 7 endpoints pass (treasury, sync-status, sync-run, stakings, RBAC, P0-4 410-Gone). FRONTEND: /admin/prosper/inversiones is broken — Stakings (CMS live) tab is default, but Treasury/Sync/Stakings cards never load data. Browser dev-tools confirm ZERO network calls to /api/v1/admin/prosper/* despite SWR hooks being declared. Direct fetch from the same browser context returns 200 with correct data, so backend + cookie auth are fine — bug is purely client-side (useSWR not firing).

ui_bugs.issue: Stuck on 'Cargando…'. data-testid='cms-treasury-usdc/arsa/xlm' never render. SWR fetcher for /v1/admin/prosper/treasury never fires (no request observed in network log).

Shows hardcoded 'DISABLED' pill + 'Aún no corrió' even though backend returns enabled=true and a populated last_run (processed=8, external_total=8). SWR for /v1/admin/prosper/staking-sync/status never fires.
Click does not trigger toast 'Staking sync ejecutado'. The POST /staking-sync/run is not fired from the browser (verified via response listener).
Both 'Nuestros' and 'Externos / históricos' sections render 'Cargando…'; the 8 expected external rows never appear; no hash links to stellar.expert.

integration_issues.issue: useSWR<Treasury>('/v1/admin/prosper/treasury', api) declared in CmsHeaderWidgets but never fires fetch on mount. Page is marked 'use client' and toast/SWR imports look fine — no JS console errors observed, no requestfailed events, no 4xx/5xx — the request simply isn't sent. Likely root causes to investigate: (a) SWRConfig provider missing/misconfigured higher up the tree, (b) the new components are tree-shaken or imported but not actually mounted (e.g. dynamic import default-export mismatch), (c) tab default state lifting issue. Confirmed working bypass: page.evaluate(fetch('/api/v1/admin/prosper/treasury',{credentials:'include'})) → 200 with full payload from the same browser session.

action_items: URGENT: Fix /admin/prosper/inversiones — none of the new CMS components fire their SWR fetches. Verify SWRConfig provider, check for any silent error in component mount, and confirm CmsHeaderWidgets + StakingsTab are actually rendered (the wrapper DOM elements with data-testids ARE present, but children show stuck 'Cargando…' / 'DISABLED' / 'Aún no corrió').
Re-run the page in browser devtools with React DevTools to see if useSWR is invoked; also check for any Next.js cache/proxy issue between /api/* and the FastAPI mount.
After fix, retest Run-now toast + filter-dropdown scope/asset/status + hash-link 6…4 truncation.
critical_code_review_comments: page.tsx is 914 lines — split CmsHeaderWidgets, StakingsTab, IntentsTab, PositionsTab, TrustlinesTab into separate files for maintainability.
TreasuryCell value rendering does not handle the case where balanceUSDC/ARSA arrive as STRING (backend returns '12.25' as string) — verify number formatting (toFixed) does not crash on string inputs.

useSWR keys are plain strings — keep them centralised in a constant to avoid drift between mutate() callers and useSWR keys (already saw globalMutate('/v1/admin/prosper/stakings?scope=all') hardcoded — will miss the actual SWR key if filters are appended).

success_rate.frontend: 10% (page shell + tab buttons + filters render, but all data widgets broken)

seed_data_creation: Triggered a staking_sync run during backend test; left 8 external positions persisted in positions collection (external=true).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is rock solid (7/7 pytest). Focus retest exclusively on /admin/prosper/inversiones rendering. Use the in-browser fetch trick (page.evaluate) to sanity-check the backend is reachable, then watch the network panel for /api/v1/admin/prosper/* — currently zero requests fire from the page mount.
rca of the issue: RCA — Backend & cookie auth are fully functional (verified by both pytest with requests session and in-browser fetch). The page mounts (its outer DOM with data-testids cms-header-widgets/cms-treasury-card/cms-sync-widget/cms-stakings-tab is present), but the SWR fetchers inside CmsHeaderWidgets and StakingsTab never execute — no fetch is sent for any of the 3 new endpoints. No console error, no pageerror, no requestfailed. This indicates either (a) the components are rendered as server components without SWR side-effects, (b) an outer SWR provider is missing causing fetcher swallow, or (c) a build/HMR stale chunk. The 'use client' directive is present on the file, ruling out (a) at source level — but a build cache or wrong barrel re-export could still convert it back to server-only. Recommended next step: hard rebuild the Next.js bundle (rm -rf .next && yarn build/dev), then if the bug persists, sprinkle console.log inside CmsHeaderWidgets to confirm it actually executes on the client.
